svg.title: Flow: joining a season, from the screen to your drawn team (attendee)
svg.text: 02 · Flow: joining a season, from the screen to your drawn team (attendee)
Use case: Demo Player sees the open season on the screen, scans, joins solo in two taps, and learns their team when the season starts

g.text: Demo Finals · teams of three, drawn for you

svg.text: The season-open card on the venue screen:
the count fills as people join; the QR opens
the Finals page in the hub.
1 · On the screen
scan

g.text: Teams of three, drawn for you
Groups of three teams, then groups of four,
a semi-final and a best-of-three final. Every
Player Five · Player Six · Player Seven

svg.text: 2 · The Finals page
In the hub's frame under Play. Signed in
and a member, one tap joins. Your name
in the season is your display name; you
can change it here.
Join solo

g.text: Your team is drawn at the start
16 of 27 are in. If 6 vote, the season starts
now with the teams the sign-ups fill.

svg.text: 3 · You're in
One entry per person, from the hub or
Discord alike. Voting to start early is the
legacy rule; the threshold is a setting.
4 · The reveal
The team builder balances the drawn
teams by ranking. Everyone's phone
shows their own team at once; the screen
shows all teams.

g.text: The season started early with 24 places.
You joined last, so you're first on the
If a player drops out before the first result,
the crew can put you in.

svg.text: 5 · Left out
The legacy's 'left out' list becomes a
substitutes' list the crew draws from
Notes

Questions for the session: U2 (how people join), U3 (solo, teams or both), U6 (voting to start early), U14 (substitutes), L11 (the reveal). The names in the season come from the person's display name; a guest added by the crew has a nickname only
